meaning:
πού
enclitic particle,
1. anywhere, somewhere: Heb.2:6 4:4.
2. in some degree, perhaps, about: Act.27:29 (T, μήπου), Rom.4:19; δή που (T, δήπου), surely: Heb.2:16.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of…
But one has somewhere testified, saying, “What is man, that you think of him? Or the son of man, that you care for him?
